text:
maria: Heads-up — ran continuous-batcher + multi-variant routing experiment. When compat sets include >=3 variants batch sizes collapse and avg batch lifetime drops. attaching profiler snippets below.

raj: I saw that. Looks like fanout across variants shards flows so requests never wait long enough to coalesce. avg_batch_size went 5.2 -> 1.9 on the canary pool.

lin: Quick perf dump from the canary (sample):
```
sample_window=60s
batch_count=4123
avg_batch_size=1.92
avg_emit_latency_ms=3.1
compat_fragmentation=0.48
kv_hit_rate=0.82
kernel_pick_jitter=0.29
fallback_rate=0.073
```

kelsey: Hypothesis: multi-variant routing increases compat_set cardinality which fragments queue shape. Two immediate knobs to try: (1) raise token_budget_target so slices wait slightly longer to form, (2) change queue policy to prefer coalescing across compat-compatible requests instead of strict variant affinity.

maria: Proposed quick config to test on canary cluster:
```yaml
batcher:
  queue_policy: aggressive_coalesce  # allow cross-variant coalesce within compat set
  token_budget_target: 480          # up from 320, target ~480 tokens to collect slightly bigger batches
  slice_fusion: stochastic(0.15)    # fuse small slices probabilistically to avoid starvation
```

raj: Also flag: kernel selection jitter is adding costs. If seq_len <= 128 prefer fused-attn-quant kernel to avoid runtime switching. That reduces kernel_pick_jitter in traces (was ~0.29).

lin: Noted KV issue on fallbacks — when requests route to fallback variants we lose local KV shard locality. Miss rate up ~+14% on those flows. Quick mitigation: pin KV shard mapping per compat set for 30s TTL so fallback traffic reuses warmed entries.

kelsey: Sounds good. TL;DR plan: 1) canary with queue_policy+token_budget change + kernel preference, 2) KV pin TTL for compat sets, 3) 1h sampling and flamegraph capture, revert on p50 latency regress >5% or error spike.

maria: I'll open canary rollout. @eng-sre please watch GPU pool (mv-canary-23) and throttle if we see saturation.

perf-bot: Canary started on pool mv-canary-23. Sampling=on. Metrics exported to /perf/canaries/2359012345.

raj: I'll glue a lightweight evaluator that runs the top-10 prompt set to measure quality/latency impact every 5m.

lin: Pushing experimental patch now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4342 (config + kernel hint). I'll post results in this thread in ~1h.

maria: thanks — keep updates short. If anything looks bad roll back immediately with deploy-bot. :thumbsup:
